title: Tidy .taad: HF-008
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: I added no test that pins HF-008's shape, which is two fitness rules with the same files and pattern reporting the same violation twice. The design lists no cases, the fix only deletes yaml, and the minor lane says 'nothing new'. The before/after hit counts above come from a throwaway probe script in %TEMP%, which was deleted afterwards.

A guard (a RuleCases shape or a rules-parity check) that refuses a settled entry whose files glob and every pattern match a twinned entry, once (?m) and including_comments are normalised away. Without one, the next slice whose build twins its design's rules can bring the same duplicate reporting back.
